title: Contract Testing Pattern — Companion Code
description: Runnable contract-testing artifacts: Pact consumer tests and provider verification in Node, a pact-python consumer example, a GitHub Actions broker publish/verify workflow, and a can-i-deploy gate script.
description_es: Artefactos ejecutables de contract testing: tests de consumidor y verificación de proveedor con Pact en Node, un ejemplo de consumidor con pact-python, un workflow de GitHub Actions para publicar/verificar en el broker y un script de puerta can-i-deploy.
